text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From a certain point during summer 
training camp, Still in Love had a clear, 
refreshed look on her face, as if the fog 
in her heart had lifted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because my emotional highs and 
lows leveled out, my instincts ran wild 
much less often after that, allowing me to 
enter the final day in great condition.
choice_data_list:
(With how Still is right now, she can take 
the Shuka Sho too...!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you look so happy, Trainer, means 
more to me than anything.
choice_data_list:
...You're just brimming with confidence, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh. I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: However... yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I will show you a run even greater than 
the Oaks... That much, I can promise."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—The Triple Tiara is right before my 
eyes... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart races. If it's her, she truly 
might... be able to pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... ...Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... It's still not enough...! 
More... I have to run... more...—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Otherwise... ...it'll all be—gone...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have... nothing...— ...Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud...)

Is this guy really eating properly? Good 
grief... What a handful...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're awake. ...How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-san... Me...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She collapsed on the beach. Pushed herself 
way too hard.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've already contacted both the camp lodge 
and the Academy. Rest here for a while.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for causing you trouble. But 
I'm all right now...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Are you going back to running again? This 
time, collapsing might not be the only 
consequence."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, really. If that's how it is... 
I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"When you say you don't care, does that 
mean you're fine with never being able to 
run again?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...! Shut up...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
This has nothing to do with you! Stop 
interfering—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Foolish girl!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You came here to run, didn't you? Yet you 
give in to despair and act so recklessly—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do not use running as a tool to corner 
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...I-I didn't mean to. I... just..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You wish to win, do you not? To prove what 
you believe in. Then do not misdirect your 
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Take better care... of yourself. Why is 
something so simple beyond you...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-san...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...When I found you collapsed, I thought 
my heart was going to stop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grip...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Such a truly troublesome fellow.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …………So warm……

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is this...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is it... love?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't need it. Something... this warm... 
I don't want it...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's completely meaningless. Isn't it? 
...Otherwise—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —I am not empty inside...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, heh...♪ Heh, heh, heh...♪

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Is Still in Love... in "high spirits"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp was... a 
"quasar." You really did "grow," didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You're right... With this, I can head into 
the Shuka Sho... with my head held high.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara— it really suits Still 
in Love, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...D-Do you really think so? ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: If Universe-san wins the Kikuka Sho too...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
A Classic Triple Crown sweep, is it? The 
sixth in history...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. If two roommates from the same 
generation... could both achieve 
greatness... that would be amazing."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"You with your crown, and I with my 
tiara... It would be wonderful if we could 
both wear them together."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If only that were the case, wouldn't that 
have been nice?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ? If that happens...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because that is our predetermined 
"destiny."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe――has a predetermined destiny 
to follow.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Because there is no "singularity."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "DTFT." You can... change the "orbit."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If "that" changes, everything changes. I 
wish for both of you to find "happiness."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Then I will... pray for your happiness 
too, Universe-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
May you be true to yourself... and find 
true happiness...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sfira.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp is over—and 
finally, the last jewel... the Shuka Sho 
approaches.
